Was driving home today, listening to the radio when I person stated an opinion I didn't agree with, I made an explanation for why I though it was wrong and was content with that, in till I realized that using that same explanation one of my own closely held beliefs would also be wrong.
You should apply you logic to your own arguments first before you apply them to others.
That's happened to me recently and since most of my beliefs have changed and I became a libertarian.

I try to do this. I spent many years in debate club, they teach you to learn to argue both sides, both to know your opponent's arguments and be ready for them, and to make sure they cannot refute yours.

I try to argue both sides to myself before forming strong opinions. I generally end up frustrated because nothing is as black and white as many folks seem to think.

But I feel like a better and smarter person, so there's at least that.
